BiblicalUsage: Hoglah is one of the five daughters of Zelophehad, and her name is tied to the law of inheritance. She stands with her sisters before Moses and Eleazar to claim her father's portion, because he died without a son, and the Lord grants their cause and changes the law for every daughter after them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hoglah's claim is the picture of faith asking boldly for what God has promised. I hold that her story shows the law can bend toward justice when God's people plead rightly.
